scenes.name: Demo: Pad under pluck
scenes.blurb: A velvet pad holds the chords and a kalimba arpeggio plays above it, two parts instead of one. Intros are the pad alone and breakdowns the kalimba's rests. A/B: Layers in the control panel (One, Pad, Rhythm, Both)

scenes.name: Demo: Layers over time
scenes.blurb: The layers move on their own: strings alone, then strings under a harp, the harp alone, both again, then one voice, two phrases at each stop and round again. Control panel, Over time

scenes.name: Demo: Breathing cadences
scenes.blurb: Phrase ends lean back in tempo, section ends more; the flute adds graces, turns and trills. A/B: “Breathe into cadences”, “Decorate the melody”

scenes.name: Demo: Strong and soft
scenes.blurb: Accents speak quick and bright, soft notes swell in slow and dark; phrases swing wide. A/B: the dynamics rules in “The performance”

scenes.name: Demo: Make room
scenes.blurb: The strings dip under the bell tune and return in its rests; the level stays steady as drums come and go. A/B: “Let the backing dip”, “Keep the level even”

scenes.name: Demo: Opening out
scenes.blurb: Breakdowns open into a wide room, full sections come close; builds often lift a whole step. A/B: “Let sections open out”, “Lift the key”

scenes.name: Demo: Groove slider
scenes.blurb: A steady four-on-the-floor groove under a busy bell lead and a drive bass, set half-way off the beat. A/B: “Push the groove off the beat” - none is straight, high pushes notes half a beat early

scenes.name: Demo: Pad and bass
scenes.blurb: A nylon guitar pad over an upright bass through ii-V-I, sevenths allowed. A/B: “Leave the root to the bass” (guitar and bass do not need the root twice) and “Add sevenths where they pull” (only the V is a seventh chord)

scenes.name: Demo: Generated chords
scenes.blurb: A soft pad, a warm bass and a flute, over chords drawn fresh each cycle from rock-corpus statistics in a wistful mood. A/B: “Generate the chord progression”, then the brightness, stability, adventure and change sliders

scenes.name: Demo: Two-minute wave
scenes.blurb: An energy arc in two minutes: calm, dark and sparse, full after one minute, then calm again. A/B: “Shape the energy”

scenes.name: Demo: Living colour
scenes.blurb: Every eight bars the pad and lead lean to a slightly different colour around their own sound. A/B: “Let the sounds’ colour drift”

scenes.name: Demo: Shifting metre
scenes.blurb: A 4/4 groove whose breakdowns turn into a lilting 6/8 with half-time drums, then come back. A/B: “Give breakdowns their own metre”, “Play breakdowns in half time”

scenes.name: Demo: Seven-eight
scenes.blurb: A whole piece in 7/8, felt as 2+2+3: the long third beat gives it a limp that keeps rolling. Pick another metre in the Music panel to compare

scenes.name: Bossa in Seven
scenes.blurb: A light bossa feel in 7/8: Rhodes chords, a felt bass and a harp, the skyline lighting up at dusk

scenes.name: Demo: Bass figures
scenes.blurb: One bass figure per phrase from the grouped bass: re-struck, anticipated, syncopated, octave. A held bare root only appears while the lead plays. Pad and drums stay plain.

scenes.name: Neon Overpass
scenes.blurb: A driving bass in changing figures under a Deep Pulse, electro beat and bell lead, over a pink, purple and blue skyline

scenes.name: Demo: Low note, then chord
scenes.blurb: The pad's low-note-then-chord pulse only, over a quiet half-bar bass: the root comes back with the first chord stab of each group instead of being held under a rootless chord.

scenes.name: Demo: Struck leads, no trills
scenes.blurb: Celesta lead with ornaments at full: graces and mordents only, never a trill. Swap the lead for a piano or the Wind Lead and trills return on long notes.

scenes.name: Demo: Song in lounge style
scenes.blurb: Rainy café with a lounge melody: every seed is its own late, off-the-beat tune, written over these chords

scenes.name: Demo: Song in hook style
scenes.blurb: Uplifting Trance Departures with a hook melody: every seed is its own repeated riff, written over these chords

scenes.name: Demo: Song in game style
scenes.blurb: Boss Fight, Politely with a game melody: every seed is its own arpeggio-led theme, written over these chords

scenes.name: Outrun After Midnight
scenes.blurb: Eighties machine pop: a gated snare and clap, eighth-note bass pulse, a saw chord and an outrun lead, with a tom fill closing each phrase, under a neon skyline

scenes.name: Rainfall Breaks
scenes.blurb: Drum and bass at 170: a rolling broken beat with ghost snares under a plucked arpeggio and a sub bass, a bright lead answered by a kalimba, rain on a neon skyline. Its half-time groove drops the snare to 3 for sixteen bars at a time

scenes.name: Wet Pavement Two-Step
scenes.blurb: UK garage at 130: skipping kicks around a snare on 2 and 4, off-beat hats and a shaker, Rhodes chords and a rubber bass, rain on the city

scenes.name: Warehouse Lift
scenes.blurb: A 909 warehouse beat that climbs through its stages as the chords change: groove, variation, build, then the drop

scenes.name: Acid Jack Afterhours
scenes.blurb: A 909 acid-house journey; every chord follows the arrangement, stage by stage, through fills and breakdowns

scenes.name: Electro Story
scenes.blurb: An 808 electro-funk groove telling a story across sixteen bars: intro, groove, variation, fill, breakdown, build, drop

scenes.name: Dub Pulse Basement
scenes.blurb: A slow 808 dub cycle with a heavy kick; the second chord drops to a breakdown and the fourth turns around

scenes.name: Boom Bap Bakery
scenes.blurb: A dusty 808 boom bap: a swung kick and snare, warm Rhodes chords, a soft sub and a music box hook that closes into a filtered breakdown

scenes.name: Trap House Tuesday
scenes.blurb: Half-time trap at 140: a sliding 808 sub on the kicks, sparse dark plucks, a bell hook and rolling hats that fill every eight bars

scenes.name: Dusty Vinyl Sunday
scenes.blurb: Slow lo-fi hip hop at 78: a lazy swung beat, soft keys, a felt bass and a clarinet that answers itself, with a vinyl-warm filter that breathes

scenes.name: Uplifting Trance Departures
scenes.blurb: Modern uplifting trance at 138: held supersaw chords on a syncopated 3-3-2 push, an off-beat bass and a long-note lead hook that repeats and answers itself, with 8-bar builds that rise through a high-pass into the drop

scenes.name: Progressive Night Bus
scenes.blurb: Rolling progressive trance at 130: a patient off-beat bass, plucked arpeggios that thin and return, and a resonant lead over long filter sweeps

scenes.name: Minimal Click Lab
scenes.blurb: Sparse minimal tech at 126: tiny clicks and rim shots, a patient off-beat sub, one or two stabs a bar and a lone blip of a lead; the room is the instrument and the filter opens over sixteen bars

scenes.name: Slow House Sunset
scenes.blurb: Chilled house at 100 with an 808: a warm Rhodes stab on the off-beats, a soft sub bounce and a flute that glides between notes while the filter breathes

scenes.name: Deep Pocket Daydream
scenes.blurb: A deep, slow house pocket at 96: swung hats on a soft 808 kick, plucked keys, a rounded bass and a kalimba that daydreams over the top

scenes.name: Disco Ride Afternoon
scenes.blurb: Lazy disco-house at 104: a ride cymbal over a gentle 808 kick, organ stabs on the off-beat, a springy bass and a music box tune
